units.source_text: 即使我現在馬上從這裡出走，也會被人們在額頭上烙下瘋子的印記，不，或許烙下的是廢人吧。

en.t: Even if I ran away from here right now, people would brand my forehead with the mark of a madman; no, perhaps with the mark of a ruined man.

units.source_text: 我已徹底變得不再是個人了。

en.t: I had completely ceased to be human.

units.source_text: 來到這裡時正值初夏，從鐵窗向外望，能看見醫院院內小小的池塘裡，綻放著紅色的睡蓮。

en.t: It was early summer when I came here, and through the barred window I could see red water lilies blooming in the small pond in the hospital courtyard.

units.source_text: 三個月過去了，醫院院內的波斯菊開始含芳吐豔。

en.t: Three months passed, and the cosmos flowers in the hospital courtyard began to bloom.
